'''Execute Battalion''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] battalion within the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion.]] It was commanded by [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]] Execute Battalion, originally stationed aboard the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], manned the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] designated [[ATAT300/Legends|ATAT300]] and, along with two other brigades and two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], boarded a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and proceeded to hunt the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], wanted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for numerous crimes.

==Appearances==
